purpose: Preserve the next strategy hypothesis independently of chat/context state.
hypothesis: H5 combo-continuation value may interact with the substantially stronger H6C row-transition policy. A flatter/less jagged board may make preserving combo state more valuable because future high-base clears can be realized more reliably.

why_revisit_h5.h5_decision: not promoted alone; positive but insufficiently stable
why_revisit_h5.interaction_reason: H6C changed board-shape incentives enough that the marginal value of combo continuation may no longer match the H2-era result.

protocol.selection: screen on shared seeds, validate survivors on fresh seeds, then fixed-finalist confirmation on new holdout seeds

promotion_rule: Do not promote from screening or validation alone. A fixed H7 finalist must beat the H6C incumbent on fresh paired KO confirmation under the same standard used for H6C.
follow_up_if_positive: Use surviving combo scale together with useful attack and row-transition scale as the first small joint-optimization set before search/exploration tuning.
follow_up_if_negative: Keep combo scale at 1.0, retain H6C as incumbent, and move to the next interaction or joint-tuning dimension rather than rescuing H5 post hoc.
